### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco is excited to continue our support to the F\-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office. This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F\-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.


Our **Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Program Analyst**, located in Crystal City, Arlington, VA, supports the F\-35 JPO Future Capability \& Technology (FCAT) Directorate in its mission in achieving Kill\-Chain dominance through Intelligence, robust Operational Analysis (OA), requirements integration and analysis, and Research and Technology exploration, for all elements of the F\-35 Air System. Our Program Analyst supports FCAT in leading, identifying, maturing, informing, and transitioning capability candidate nominations and integration planning for insertion into the F\-35 Air System Program of Record (PoR), to and on behalf of the U.S. Services and International Partner countries.


Our Program Analysts review and evaluate business systems and user needs. Formulates systems to parallel overall business strategies. Write detailed descriptions of user needs, program functions, and steps required to develop or modify computer programs. Familiar with relational database concepts, and client\-server concepts. Relies on experience and judgment to plan and accomplish goals. Performs a variety of complicated tasks. May lead and direct the work of others. May report directly to a project lead or manager. A wide degree of creativity and latitude is expected.

  



**This position is contingent upon your ability to maintain/transfer an active DoD Secret security clearance.**  

  



In this role, you will:


* Intelligence – Assist FCAT in providing all intelligence support required across the three Intel pillars of Threat, Intel Supportability Analysis (SA), and Intel Disclosure/Release by supporting every aspect of the program. Assist FCAT in serving as the designated liaison between the Program and the Services and Intel community; providing constantly updated current and forecast threat information to stakeholders to drive requirements and engineering analysis.
* Assist FCAT in ensuring all intelligence equities involved with fielding and exporting F\-35 (e.g., intelligence mission data) are defined, engineered, and sustained.
* Air System Requirements Assessment, Development, and Approval in collaboration with External Stakeholders. Assist FCAT in managing the Pre\-PoR F\-35 Air System Requirements and in creating, maintaining, and promulgating a comprehensive Roadmap to inform the PMOs of risks and opportunities for the F\-35 Program.
* Assist FCAT in developing the F\-35 Flight Plan which provides an integrated strategy for F\-35 capabilities focusing on Participant’s future requirements over the next five to ten years and ensuring warfighter capability need dates are being clearly communicated to the PoR activities within the JPO. Assist FCAT in maturing and recommending for approval all new F\-35 requirements, developing the Flight Plan and New Capabilities Decision Memoranda.
* Research and Technology (R\&T) – assist FCAT in researching and assisting in development of technology through discovery, sponsorship, candidate studies and analysis, maturation, prototyping, experimentation, demonstration, and transition for relevant technology solutions for consideration and prioritization to transition into the F\-35 PoR.
* Strategic Acquisition and Transition Planning (SATP) – assist FCAT in developing strategy for incorporating capability requirements defined by the Air Systems Requirements (ASR) team and technology developed by the R\&T team into an acquisition program that is ready to be incorporated into the PoR and transitioned to the PMOs for execution.
* Program Strategy – assist FCAT in integrating research and emerging policy in National Defense Strategy, global geo\-political domains, warfighting tactics, operations, kill chain, applied technology domain, global business, and market practices into F\-35 JPO Program Strategy as well as in providing effective coaching and maintains strategic dialogue with JPO and external stakeholders.
* Governance Structure – assist FCAT in leading Requirements Working Group (RWG), Operational Advisory Group (OAG), Senior Warfighter Group (SWG), JSF (Joint Strike Fighter) Executive Steering Board (JESB) and in assisting with Configuration Steering Board (CSB) and requirements portion of the U.S. Executive Steering Group.
* Transfer requirements from the FCAT to the PoR – assist FCAT in providing applicable acquisition documentation and planning materials to the PMOs for execution, in collaboration with the PMOs.

* Coordinate with stakeholders to gather technical requirements and monitor project progress

* Support the adoption of technical project management methodologies and best practices

* Participate in initiative planning and contribute to project coordination efforts
* Represent technical project management in team\-level planning and delivery discussions

* 2\+ years of relevant project management experience, supporting technical project teams
* Proficient in managing technical project tasks, timelines, and deliverables in collaboration with engineering, IT, and vendor teams

* Experience with coordinating technical teams, managing vendor deliverables, and supporting project execution and reporting
* Advanced knowledge of project tracking and reporting tools (e.g. ADO (preferred), Power BI, ServiceNow) to support transparency, accountability, and performance monitoring
* Experience with Agile project delivery in a technical environment
* Working knowledge of other project delivery methodologies
* Working knowledge of risk identification, change control, and stakeholder communication in technical environments
* Basic skill in translating technical updates into business\-friendly reporting formats and supporting leadership presentations

jobs.description:
**Chief of Staff / Senior Program Manager** **Location:** National Capital Region**Level:** Senior Manager / Director**Clearance:** Secret *All candidates must already possess a Secret clearance. All candidates must be able to obtain and maintain their current clearance and any clearance level designated by Montcure at any given time during their employment.* *Montcure, LLC is a Service\-Disabled Veteran\-Owned Small Business (SDVOSB) founded with a vision to revolutionize consulting and advisory services through innovative, data\-driven solutions. The Montcure team recognizes the unique challenges faced by organizations and governments in today’s rapidly evolving business environment.*
Job Summary  

Montcure, LLC is hiring a Chief of Staff / Senior Program Manager to support clients within the Department of War (DoW). This dual role combines internal, personnel\-focused leadership as Chief of Staff with external, client\-facing program management responsibilities.  

As Chief of Staff (internal), you will report to the Director of Client Solutions and the Director of Strategic Growth and will work alongside all directors, particularly the Director of Strategic Growth. You will focus on personnel management, staff standards, firm\-wide contractual and quality oversight, and internal coordination. You will set performance and quality standards for all staff, partner with HR on formal performance management, coordinate with Operations, IT, the Facility Security Officer (FSO), and other internal functions, and establish formal processes to monitor delivery quality, timeliness, and contractual performance across all firm contracts.  

As Senior Program Manager (external), you will lead client\-facing program delivery and support. This includes coordinating the executive’s time, priorities, and decision points; managing battle rhythm and briefing materials; providing program management of client initiatives; and supporting IT efforts that streamline audit response operations.  

Our core value of Dependability is paramount in both dimensions of the role. **Key Responsibilities**  

Internal – Chief of Staff (Personnel, Staff Standards \& Quality Oversight Focus)* Set and uphold clear standards for quality, responsiveness, confidentiality, and accuracy for all staff across the organization.
* Own the organization’s senior staff meeting cadence, offsites, and all\-hands communications, ensuring clear follow\-up and accountability on action items.
* Work alongside all directors, particularly the Director of Strategic Growth, to support aligned execution of leadership priorities.
* Translate leadership priorities into structured implementation plans with owners, milestones, dependencies, and success metrics; track execution and escalate risks before they become crises.
* Coordinate across internal teams and components to break down silos, resolve cross\-cutting issues, and keep interdependent workstreams synchronized.
* Prepare the executive for internal and external engagements with tight, decision\-ready briefing materials.
* Filter, synthesize, and prioritize the volume of issues, requests, and correspondence competing for the executive’s attention, ensuring nothing critical is missed.
* Represent the executive in meetings and forums as needed, with authority to speak to priorities and relay decisions.
* Build and maintain trusted working relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners as required.
* Manage sensitive personnel, political, and interagency matters with discretion, escalating appropriately and protecting the executive’s credibility and options.
* Diagnose organizational and process bottlenecks within the executive office and broader organization, and design and implement practical fixes.
* Lead or oversee special projects and rapid\-response taskings directed by leadership, standing up temporary teams as needed.
* Partner with Human Resources to conduct formal staff performance reviews twice per year, ensuring timely, documented feedback and accountability.
* Oversee the formal new\-hire performance program (implemented by the HR team) featuring structured 30\-, 60\-, and 90\-day reviews following each employee’s official start date.
* Collaborate with Operations, IT, the Facility Security Officer (FSO), and other internal functions to address performance concerns or matters requiring leadership coordination when performance impacts delivery quality, clearances, or the IT tools required for effective service delivery.
* Interact with all firm clients to monitor and assess delivery quality, timeliness, and contractual performance against core client areas and the applicable statements of work.
* Establish and lead a formal quality review function that periodically engages client representatives to address service quality and contract compliance.
* Design and implement a formal quality program featuring quantifiable scoring criteria to evaluate service quality and performance across each of the firm’s contracts, and use the resulting data to drive continuous improvement and accountability.

* Support client delivery of IT initiatives designed to streamline audit response operations, improve data integrity, and enhance reporting efficiency.
* Coordinate across client organizations and stakeholders as needed to resolve cross\-cutting issues and keep interdependent workstreams synchronized.
* Prepare decision\-ready materials and support client executives for key engagements as required.

jobs.title: Cybersecurity Analyst/Information System Secu
jobs.description:
SHR Consulting Group, LLC is a small business delivering enterprise IT, cybersecurity, and program management services to the Department of Defense and federal civilian agencies. We support mission\-critical infrastructure at the Pentagon and across the National Capital Region, and we invest in our people through competitive compensation, professional certification support, and long\-term career growth on stable, multi\-year programs.


We are seeking a **Cybersecurity Analyst / Information System Security Officer (ISSO)** to provide cybersecurity, risk management, compliance, and continuous monitoring support for Federal Emergency Management Agency (FEMA) information systems and cloud environments. The ISSO works with FEMA system owners, Information System Security Managers (ISSMs), technical teams, and cybersecurity stakeholders to maintain system security posture and compliance with **DHS/FEMA** cybersecurity requirements, FISMA, and the NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF).

**Key Responsibilities**

* Support implementation and ongoing execution of the **NIST Risk Management Framework (RMF)** and DHS/FEMA security policies and procedures.
* Develop, maintain, and update system security documentation, including **System Security Plans (SSPs), Security Assessment Reports (SARs), Plans of Action and Milestones (POA\&Ms), Contingency Plans, Configuration Management Plans, and related authorization artifacts**.
* Support **Assessment and Authorization (A\&A)** activities for FEMA systems, applications, and cloud environments.
* Maintain security documentation and evidence within applicable **DHS/FEMA governance, risk, and compliance (GRC) systems**.
* Conduct and document security control assessments and support implementation and validation of **NIST SP 800\-53 security and privacy controls**.
* Track cybersecurity findings, vulnerabilities, POA\&Ms, remediation activities, and risk acceptance through closure.
* Review vulnerability scanning and security monitoring results from tools such as **Tenable/Nessus, CrowdStrike, Elastic, and other DHS/FEMA\-approved security platforms**.
* Coordinate with system administrators, cloud engineers, DevSecOps teams, application teams, and system owners to remediate vulnerabilities and configuration deficiencies.
* Support **continuous monitoring**, including recurring security control reviews, vulnerability management, configuration compliance, and required reporting.
* Review proposed system and infrastructure changes to identify cybersecurity impacts and ensure security requirements are incorporated throughout the system lifecycle.
* Support compliance with applicable **DHS security directives, FEMA policies, FISMA, FedRAMP, NIST guidance, and federal cybersecurity requirements**.
* Assist with incident response activities, security investigations, audit requests, and cybersecurity reporting as required.
* Participate in security reviews, technical meetings, change management activities, and coordination with FEMA cybersecurity stakeholders.
* Identify cybersecurity risks and provide practical recommendations for mitigation, remediation, or risk management.
* Maintain audit\-ready security documentation and supporting evidence.

**Minimum Qualifications**

jobs.title: EOD Project Manager
jobs.description:
Applied Research Associates (ARA) seeks an experienced **EOD Project Manager** to support government Research and Development (R\&D) efforts in support of the Defense Threat Reduction Agency (DTRA). This highly skilled person will participate in strategic discussions to support development programs of defeat technologies and material solutions to support global integration.


The Senior EOD Project Manager performs a variety of tasks, will provide consultation and direction on complex projects and will be a top\-level contributor/specialist.


Applicants should have extensive experience in the areas of Explosive Ordinance Disposal support and best practices, paired with application in the design, implementation, and integration of supporting systems. Experience in biological, chemical, and mechanical EOD materials and devices is preferred.


This Project Manager investigates and analyzes unique or highly technical manufacturing systems and provides technical assistance in establishing procedures and methods to integrate support. You will evaluate complex programs and measures to assess the efficacy of integrations.


**EOD Project Manager Security Clearance / Location / Requirements:**


* **Must be US Citizen.**
* **Clearance \- this position requires a TS\-SCI clearance.**
* Bachelors degree with 10\-12 years of related work experience.
* 3 years of experience at DTRA.
* Location \- this position requires residence near Fort Belvoir, Virginia.
* Ability to clearly articulate new concepts and capabilities to the team and customers.
* Experience in DOD Project management, Research and Development is preferred.
* Travel (3 to 5 days a month) to advise and provide direction on advanced R\&D programs.

**EOD Project Manager Primary Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Serving as Senior EOD Project Manager to control development of assigned R\&D technology.
* Drive engineering project execution, develop and recommend technical guidance, track and report on status, and resolve blocking issues.
* Coordinate cross\-team efforts spanning internal customers and external partners.
* Interfacing with external agencies supporting systems engineering, architecture, and/or design.
* Performing Functional Allocation; Create and Maintain Specifications.
* Supporting System Deployment developing and reviewing Factory, Installation, and Performance Acceptance Testing Documents.
* Developing Requirements Verification Strategies and Plans.
* Developing Integrated Systems Security Solutions.
* Travel to customer facilities to assist with technical issues.

**EOD Project Manager Secondary Duties and Responsibilities:**


* Provide subject matter expertise with system analysis, design, delivery, verification, and troubleshooting of designated systems.
* Generate technical documents, such as test plans and procedures.
* Provide technical input/feedback to the development team.

Anticipated salary range: $160k\-$180k. Offer may vary depending on experience and skill set.


**Who is ARA?**


Do you want to work for a purpose? Applied Research Associates, Inc. (aka ARA) is an employee\-owned international research and engineering company. We have been providing technically superior solutions to complex and challenging problems in the physical sciences since 1979\. ARA has over 2,240 employee\-owners and continues to grow rapidly. Together, our offices throughout the U.S. and Canada provide a broad range of technical expertise in defense, civil, and health technologies, computer software, and simulation, systems analysis, environmental technologies, and testing and measurement.


ARA also prides itself, on having a challenging culture where innovation \& experimentation are the norms. The motto, “Engineering and Science for Fun and Profit” sums up the ARA experience. Employee ownership ensures you have a voice in what happens in the company.


To find out more about what the Intelligence, Surveillance \& Reconnaissance Division has to offer, visit our website at: https://www.ara.com/benefits/

* Bachelors or better

The Program Analyst provides analytical, evaluative, and process improvement support for PRE mission operations, quality assurance activities, and policy\-related documentation. Supports efforts to assess and improve the efficiency and effectiveness of operational processes and work products across the organization. Assists in developing and maintaining quality assurance tools, metrics, and reporting mechanisms used to monitor the consistency and quality of planning, advisory, and transactional documents and related activities within PRE. Supports the collection, analysis, and reporting of performance data to help identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement in program operations.


Job Duties:

* Provides analytical, advisory, and administrative support for Bureau management programs, including program planning, budgeting support, acquisition planning support, and preparation of recurring and ad hoc reports for internal and external stakeholders, with a focus on real property projects and transactions supporting the overseas portfolio.
* Coordinates with customers to gather, clarify and validate project and transaction requirements, ensuring submissions reflect operational needs, align with established priorities, and meet program standards.
* Coordinates with Department\-level offices (e.g., Program and Policy Planning, Budget, Acquisition, and Legislative Affairs) to gather information, clarify requirements, and support program execution activities.

* Supports the development of policies, issuances, and directives by researching requirements, compiling background information, and assisting in drafting materials for review and approval by authorized Bureau officials.
* Assists in tracking policy\-related issues affecting Bureau missions and functions.

* Supports planning and coordination activities through preparation of briefing materials, presentations, reports, and supporting documentation for senior leadership review.
* Compiles and organizes data used in planning processes, including inputs supporting budget and program resource planning.
* Reviews submissions for completeness, consistency, and adherence to instructions and prepares summaries for review by authorized officials.
* Maintains planning documentation and updates as directed.
* Participates in meetings, briefings, and conferences in a support capacity.

* Collaborate with staff, leadership, customers, and stakeholders across the Directorate to support program activities.

jobs.description:
Overview:

Systems Planning and Analysis, Inc. (SPA) delivers high\-impact, technical solutions to complex national security issues. With over 50 years of business expertise and consistent growth, we are known for continuous innovation for our government customers, in both the US and abroad. Our exceptionally talented team is highly collaborative in spirit and practice, producing *Results that Matter*. Come work with the best! We offer opportunity, unique challenges, and clear\-sighted commitment to the mission. Objective. Responsive. Trusted.  

The AUKUS, Submarines, and Industrial Base Group (ASIG), within the Sea, Land, Air Division, provides timely, objective, analytic assessments that integrate technical, operational, programmatic, policy and business analysis to NAVSEA Team Submarine program offices and key stakeholders surrounding submarine platform construction. Team Submarine unifies submarine platform procurement activities, which includes the Columbia\-class SSBN program (a Major Defense Acquisition Program and the Navy’s top acquisition priority), the Virginia\-class SSN program and the new SSN\-X program (developing the next generation attack submarine), to bring improved capabilities to our undersea forces. Analysts and Engineers supporting Team Submarine will continue SPA’s decades of support to the submarine force, as well as supporting oversight of cutting\-edge attack submarine construction, assisting in developing the design requirements for the SSN platform of the future, and helping plan and execute new and innovative strategies to strengthen the critical submarine shipbuilding industrial base. These are high\-profile, major acquisition and manufacturing programs of significant importance to the future capabilities of the US Navy in an era of renewed strategic competition.\#FC \#Dice
Responsibilities:

This position supports the In\-Service Undersea Special Mission Systems Program Office (PMS 390J) which is part of Naval Sea Systems Command (NAVSEA) and Team Submarine (TSUB). This role will provide Program Management support to the Undersea Special Mission Systems program office (PMS 390\) located at the Washington Navy Yard in Washington, DC. PMS 390’s mission includes: Assessment/Underwater Work System (AUWS), Submarine Rescue System\-Rescue Capable System (SRS\-RCS), and the Submarine Rescue System\-Submarine Decompression System (SRS\-SDS). They are also responsible for the coordination of R\&D initiatives, acquisition, test and evaluation, in\-service support, and recommending certification of Dry Deck Shelter (DDS) and Special Operations Forces (SOF) Host Submarine (HOSUB) Systems. This includes responsibility for future SOF Undersea Mobility Systems and technical support for all matters pertaining to SOF Undersea Mobility; and other projects as directed. This position specifically supports the future advanced SOF maritime capabilities branch.  

Specific responsibilities will include but not be limited to:* Program management support for planning and development of Undersea Special Mission Systems
* Support strategic planning efforts by gathering, organizing, and analyzing data related to program objectives, capability gaps, emerging technologies, and fleet needs.
* Providing program management support to PMS 390J in support of SOCOM, TEAMSUB, and DCS program objectives.
* Coordinating with government stakeholders, contractor teams, technical representatives, logistics personnel, and operational users to support timely information exchange and issue resolution.
* Scheduling, coordinate, and document internal and external program meetings, including agendas, meeting minutes, and action items.
* Facilitate contractor discussions, as directed, and track deliverables, commitments, and follow\-up actions to closure.
* Conduct research on innovative solutions, commercial technologies, industry trends, and Navy/DoD modernization initiatives to identify opportunities that align with program priorities.

  

This position is located at the Washington Navy Yard. Up to 20% travel is expected, but customer requirements may change.
Qualifications:
**Required Qualifications:*** Bachelor’s level degree, Engineering/technical degree is preferred.
* Previous Submarine Experience
* Knowledge of Submarine Hull, Mechanical and Electrical Subsystems
* Knowledge of organizational structure of NAVSEA/TEAMSUB/DRPM Subs (programmatic and technical)
* Experience writing formal correspondence/ letters in NAVSEA/TEAMSUB/DRPM Subs
* Experience coordinating multi\-organizational meetings (programmatic and technical)
* Leading contractor meetings (e.g., Shipbuilder (Electric Boat)), holding contractors accountable for deliverables
* Ability to organize tasks and track them to completion
* 3\-5 years of experience supporting program management, acquisition, logistics, financial, technical, or analytical functions within a Navy, DoW, or federal program office
* The ability to work in the office at the WNY 5 days per week
* Experience supporting senior military or civilian clients
* Project management experience
* Active DoW SECRET security clearance and the ability to maintain it throughout employment

jobs.description:
**Senior Business Analyst**


**Location:** Towson, Maryland

  

  

ATS is seeking an experienced **Senior Business Analyst** to support the assessment, development, enhancement, and implementation of technology solutions for County agencies. The Senior Business Analyst will primarily focus on **public safety systems, business process improvement, requirements analysis, system implementation, and technology integration**.


The initial assignment will support the replacement of the County's **Jail Management System**. Business requirements have already been captured, and the Senior Business Analyst will work closely with County stakeholders, subject matter experts, technology teams, application developers, and vendors to validate and refine requirements, evaluate solutions, support vendor activities, and assist with the successful implementation of the new system.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Develop functional and non\-functional system requirements based on documented business requirements.
* Work with development teams and vendors to create prototype designs for medium\- to large\-risk projects.
* Analyze business processes, workflows, data flows, and existing systems to identify opportunities for improvement.
* Develop system designs, integration requirements, and delivery roadmaps.
* Translate business and client requirements into detailed system design and functional specification documentation.
* Gather, consolidate, analyze, and communicate information from subject matter experts and business stakeholders.
* Partner with business users, project managers, application developers, and vendors throughout the system development and implementation lifecycle.
* Develop detailed test plans, test scripts, and testing documentation based on functional requirements.
* Facilitate and support **User Acceptance Testing (UAT)** activities.
* Support internal and external system integrations, including design, testing, troubleshooting, and implementation.
* Conduct in\-depth analysis of County systems, operations, procedures, and business processes.
* Identify problems, assess business opportunities, and recommend technology\-based solutions.
* Gather and document business requirements for change requests, including break/fix activities.
* Support system implementation and post\-production activities as a primary technical resource.
* Provide technical assistance, consultation, and recommendations to County agencies throughout project implementation.
* Develop and monitor metrics related to reporting, system performance, and process control.
* Participate in or conduct user training as required.
* Identify and promote innovative solutions and improvements to existing processes.
* Provide high\-quality customer service and maintain effective working relationships with internal and external stakeholders.
* Maintain the security and confidentiality of proprietary and sensitive information.

**Required Qualifications**


* Bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university in **Business, Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field**.
* Minimum of **five (5\) years of professional experience** in systems analysis, business analysis, change management analysis, project management, program analysis, or a closely related field.
* Demonstrated experience supporting **public safety implementations and post\-production environments** as a primary technical resource.
* Strong knowledge of the principles and practices involved in planning, developing, implementing, and maintaining information systems.
* Strong understanding of business process analysis and evaluation.
* Experience analyzing administrative processes and identifying opportunities for automation.
* Ability to analyze the feasibility and suitability of information technology projects.
* Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with business and technical stakeholders.
* Strong technical documentation skills, including the ability to develop business requirements, functional specifications, test plans, and test scripts.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong analytical, critical\-thinking, and problem\-solving abilities.
* Ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**


* Experience working directly for or supporting a **government entity**.
* **Five (5\) or more years of experience supporting public safety projects**.
* Experience with corrections, criminal justice, law enforcement, jail management, or other public safety applications is highly desirable.

**Ideal Candidate**


The ideal candidate is a senior\-level Business Analyst who can operate comfortably between **business stakeholders and technical teams**. This individual should be highly skilled at translating business needs into actionable technical requirements and documentation, while also having hands\-on experience with complex technology implementations.


Candidates with experience supporting **public safety, corrections, criminal justice, law enforcement, or government technology programs** are especially encouraged to apply.


**Security Requirements**


Due to the confidential nature of the assignment, the selected candidate will be required to undergo a **background check** and display a County\-issued security badge at County locations.


**What We're Looking For**


**Core Skills:**


* Senior Business Analysis
* Systems Analysis
* Requirements Gathering \& Documentation
* Functional \& Non\-Functional Requirements
* Business Process Analysis
* System Design
* Systems Integration
* Software/Technology Implementation
* UAT \& System Testing
* Test Plans \& Test Scripts
* Technical Documentation
* Stakeholder \& Vendor Management
* Process Improvement
* Public Safety Systems

jobs.description:
**Job Title:** Requirements Engineer / Business Analyst


**Job ID:** 5932


**City:** Suitland


**State:** MD


**Job Type:** Full\-time


**Compensation:** $160,000 to $180,000 per Year



Centurion is currently seeking a Requirements Engineer / Business Analyst that leads the elicitation, analysis, documentation, validation, and lifecycle management of business, functional, technical, operational, security, and performance requirements for complex enterprise technology initiatives. The role translates stakeholder needs into clear, testable requirements; maintains traceability from business objectives through design, development, testing, implementation, and operations; facilitates reviews and working sessions; evaluates changes and dependencies; and produces the analytical and governance artifacts needed for successful solution delivery.
  

  

The Requirements Engineer / Business Analyst serves as a key analytical and advisory resource supporting enterprise architecture, technology governance, engineering working groups, and modernization initiatives. The individual evaluates business and mission needs, assesses current\-state capabilities, facilitates solution analysis, supports Analysis of Alternatives (AoA), develops business and technical recommendations, and helps stakeholders make informed decisions regarding enterprise technologies, infrastructure, services, and modernization investments. The role bridges business, operational, architectural, and engineering perspectives to enable successful planning and execution of enterprise initiatives.
  

  

Program Description: This program requires enterprise architecture, technology modernization, project management, and systems integration support for a complex enterprise information technology environment. The program focuses on assessing, designing, implementing, governing, and continuously improving enterprise technology capabilities to ensure they align with organizational objectives, operational requirements, security standards, and evolving business needs.
  

  

The effort includes enterprise architecture development, technology assessments, modernization planning, project delivery oversight, governance support, requirements management, and strategic technology planning. Services encompass the development of current\-state and future\-state architectures, technology roadmaps, architecture governance processes, system lifecycle management, requirements traceability, risk management, performance monitoring, and solution delivery oversight. The program supports the successful planning, implementation, operation, and continuous improvement of mission\-critical enterprise systems while promoting scalability, interoperability, security, resilience, and long\-term operational sustainability.
  

  

Responsibilities:
  

* Lead stakeholder engagement activities including interviews, workshops, working groups, and requirements elicitation sessions.
* Analyze mission, business, operational, and technical needs to identify capability gaps, improvement opportunities, modernization requirements, and solution alternatives.
* Develop and maintain business, functional, technical, operational, security, data, and performance requirements and supporting artifacts.
* Translate stakeholder objectives into requirements, use cases, process models, data flows, acceptance criteria, and solution recommendations.
* Support Analysis of Alternatives (AoA), technology assessments, trade studies, capability assessments, and modernization planning activities.
* Establish and maintain traceability between business objectives, requirements, architecture decisions, implementation activities, testing, and operational outcomes.
* Assess proposed changes for impacts to scope, architecture, infrastructure, security, operations, cost, schedule, risk, and technical baselines.
* Facilitate architecture, engineering, governance, and technical review activities while documenting decisions, recommendations, actions, and approvals.
* Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects, engineers, operations teams, project managers, cybersecurity personnel, and vendors throughout the solution lifecycle.
* Produce executive\-level analyses, recommendations, decision papers, briefing materials, and governance artifacts that support enterprise decision\-making.

  

Required Skills:
  

* 12\+ years of experience in business analysis, requirements engineering, systems analysis, systems engineering, enterprise architecture support, or technology modernization initiatives.
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, Business, or a related field.
* Experience evaluating business, operational, and technical requirements within complex enterprise information technology environments.
* Experience conducting capability assessments, gap analyses, trade studies, Analysis of Alternatives (AoA), or solution evaluations.
* Experience developing and managing functional, nonfunctional, operational, security, and infrastructure requirements.
* Experience establishing and maintaining requirements traceability across architecture, design, development, testing, implementation, and operations.
* Knowledge of systems engineering principles including requirements decomposition, functional analysis, lifecycle management, verification, and validation.
* Experience facilitating stakeholder workshops, technical working groups, architecture discussions, and governance reviews.
* Strong understanding of enterprise information systems, infrastructure services, cloud platforms, networking, cybersecurity, and application ecosystems.
* Experience supporting enterprise technology environments delivering infrastructure, cloud, platform, hosting, or managed services.
* Working knowledge of one or more enterprise technology ecosystems, including AWS, Azure, Google Cloud Platform (GCP), VMware, hybrid cloud, or on\-premises infrastructure environments.

jobs.title: Group Program Manager, Enterprise PMO
jobs.description:
Forward Financing is a financial technology company based in Boston, Massachusetts with team members throughout the United States, Dominican Republic, and Canada. The company is on a mission to unlock the capital that fuels small businesses across America. Recognized as a Best Place to Work by Built In Boston and certified as a Great Place To Work, Forward is investing in its employees, technology, and customer experience – with long\-term success in mind every step of the way.


The Group Program Manager \- Enterprise PMO is the senior practitioner at the top of the Enterprise PMO, responsible for the intake, governance, reporting, dependency, and capacity discipline the function needs to be a genuine strategic partner to the business.


You will work directly with the VP Product and lead the PMO team. You will own the things that require judgment, experience, and credibility across functions, and you will develop the next generation of PMO talent beneath you.

**In This Role You Will:**
--------------------------

* Design and own how the PMO runs, including intake, governance frameworks, tooling, and reporting standards. Define the business case standard every initiative must meet before it earns a slot in the portfolio, and hold that standard when senior stakeholders push against it. Ensure Product and PMO operate from a shared system of record to build a model that scales with the business.
* Own portfolio reporting and a single source of truth that leadership can act on. Treat data quality as a first\-order problem so that no team maintains a parallel spreadsheet alongside the system of record.
* Surface systemic execution and delivery risk across Engineering, Credit, Fraud, Analytics, Sales, and Marketing early and cross\-functionally with a proposed action plan. Build the delivery risk cadence for the PMO from the ground up and identify patterns before they become problems. Own cross\-functional dependency management, mapping what each initiative needs from whom before commitments are made rather than after dates slip.
* Partner with Product, Engineering, and Analytics to build the forward\-looking initiative roadmap each quarter. Facilitate the sequencing conversation and frame trade\-offs with a commercial lens rather than just a capacity lens, ensuring the PMO has a strong voice in what gets built, in what order, and why.
* Own quarterly resource planning as well as the cross\-portfolio resource view across Engineering and Analytics to surface capacity conflicts and bottlenecks before they become delivery risks. Partner directly with Engineering and Analytics leadership without intermediaries.
* Own the steering committee and portfolio review cadence, ensuring the right decision reaches the right forum at the right time and that leadership has an honest picture of portfolio health, including where it is unflattering.
* Own initiative\-level budget tracking and benefits realization across the portfolio, measuring whether initiatives delivered what their business case claimed and feeding that back into intake. Bachelor’s degree in a related area or equivalent additional experience (4 years).

Strong familiarity with security policy manuals, appropriate ICDs, JAFANs, DoD Manuals, and guiding policy documents.  
Extensive knowledge of DD Form 254 creation, integration, and management within the Air Force acquisition process.  
Demonstrated experience assessing threat and risk to implement long\-term courses of action and risk management strategies.  
Proven ability to write, review, and edit Security Classification Guides (SCG), Exposure Contingency Plans (ECP), and Security Operating Procedures (SOPs).  


Preferred Qualifications:  


Minimum 4 years of direct experience with SAR program acquisitions.  
Demonstrated ability to work in a dynamic environment with DoD, military, civilian personnel, and industry partners.  
Willingness to travel via air and ground transportation within the Scope of the Program’s Area of Responsibility (AOR).  


Clearance Requirements:  


Current Top Secret Clearance with SCI Eligibility.  
Must possess eligibility for access to Special Access Program (SAP) Information.  
Must be willing to submit to a Counterintelligence polygraph.  


Physical Requirements:  


This position operates in a standard closed\-area office environment with a regular schedule of 7:30 AM to 4:30 PM, approximately, based on program needs.  
Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50%.  
The candidate needs to occasionally move about inside the office environment to access file cabinets, office machinery, and interact with team members.  
There are no telework or hybrid schedule options available for this role.

jobs.description:
**Location**
------------


Irvine, California


**Employment Type**
-------------------


Full time


**Location Type**
-----------------


Hybrid


**Department**
--------------


Technology and InnovationElectronic Design


**Compensation**
----------------


* $121\.5K – $167\.1K • Offers Equity • Offers Bonus • This role has an annual bonus target of 10%

The posted salary represents the lowest and highest ranges RV Tech reasonably and in good faith expects to pay for the position. Any posted salary range pertains only to the estimated starting pay for the role. Actual starting pay is based on a number of factors, including, but not limited to, the candidate’s experience, skillset, qualifications, specific competencies, relevant education, and location.


  
**About Us**
============


Rivian and Volkswagen Group Technologies is a joint venture between two industry leaders with a clear vision for automotive’s next chapter. From operating systems to zonal controllers to cloud and connectivity solutions, we’re addressing the challenges of electric vehicles through technology that will set the standards for software\-defined vehicles around the world.


The road to the future is uncharted. By combining our expertise across connectivity, AI, security and more, we’ll map a new way forward. Working together, we’ll create a future that’s more connected, more intelligent, more sustainable for everyone.


**Role Summary**
================


As RVT’s ECU portfolio scales across vehicle platforms and brand partner programs, the rigor and speed of our reliability and durability validation programs have never been more critical. Our Electrical Hardware Technical Program Management team is seeking a Senior Technical Program Manager to own the planning, coordination, and execution of R\&D validation programs for our ECU product line—ensuring every unit we ship meets the environmental, mechanical, and life\-cycle demands of the world’s most demanding automotive applications.


In this role, you will be the connective tissue between test engineers, hardware design teams, internal labs, and third\-party test facilities. You will translate program milestones into actionable test schedules, track execution against those plans, surface risks early, and drive issues to closure—all while maintaining clear visibility for stakeholders across the organization.


Your primary domain is reliability and durability: thermal cycling, vibration, shock, humidity, HALT, and accelerated life testing across ECU hardware spanning high\-compute Infotainment, Connectivity, and Zonal controllers.


This role requires strong program management instincts, a hands\-on technical foundation in hardware validation, and the organizational influence to drive complex, multi\-team test programs to successful completion.

  

**Responsibilities**
====================


* Own and maintain reliability and durability validation program schedules; align test milestones with ECU and vehicle\-level program gates across all xVT maturity phases.
* Coordinate test execution across RVT’s internal labs in Northern and Southern California and accredited third\-party test facilities; manage capacity, sample allocation, and sequencing.
* Develop and maintain the R\&D validation test plan (DVP\&R) for assigned ECU programs, ensuring coverage of thermal cycling, vibration, shock, humidity, corrosion, and accelerated life testing.
* Identify, escalate, and actively drive mitigation of program risks related to test schedule, lab availability, sample readiness, and failure closure.
* Support test readiness reviews with ECU TPMs, confirming that R\&D test infrastructure, samples, and procedures are in place ahead of each program gate.
* Author and maintain test coordination artifacts: program trackers, status reports, risk registers, and gate review packages for internal and partner audiences.
* Drive continuous improvement of R\&D test planning processes, coordination workflows, and reporting practices across the ECU validation team.

**Qualifications**
==================


Minimum Qualifications:


* 4\+ years of experience in technical program management, test engineering, or validation coordination in the automotive, aerospace, or consumer electronics industry.
* B.S. or M.S. in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Systems Engineering, or related technical field.
* Hands\-on familiarity with ECU / PCBA reliability and durability test methods: thermal cycling, vibration (random \& sine), mechanical shock, humidity, corrosion, and HALT.
* Experience developing and maintaining DVP\&R documents and reliability test plans aligned to automotive standards (ISO 16750, AEC\-Q, IEC 60068, or OEM\-specific test specs).
* Demonstrated ability to manage complex, multi\-workstream validation programs—tracking milestones, samples, lab capacity, and cross\-team dependencies simultaneously.
* Experience coordinating with both internal test labs and accredited third\-party test facilities, including scheduling, sample management, and report review.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; able to produce clear status reports, risk registers, and gate review packages for engineering and program leadership.
* Experience with Atlassian\-based tools including Jira and Confluence for program tracking, documentation, and cross\-team coordination.
* Ability to travel domestically and internationally to test laboratories, supplier sites, and vehicle program locations as needed.

Preferred Qualifications


* Experience with EV ECU hardware—Infotainment, Connectivity, BMS, or Zonal controllers—and the unique reliability and environmental requirements of electrified vehicle platforms.

**Total Rewards**
-----------------


We build the exceptional — and we believe the people doing that work should be rewarded accordingly. In addition to a competitive base salary, full\-time positions may be is eligible to participate in our annual company performance bonus

That belief was championed by a group of community activists we still honor today as the “12 Angry Seniors.” Their mission continues to guide everything we do.


Today, SCAN is a nonprofit health organization serving more than 500,000 people across Arizona, California, Nevada, New Mexico, Texas, and Washington, with over $8 billion in annual revenue. CAP Tracking \& Monitoring – Track CAP activities through completion, maintain status updates, and follow up with business owners to support timely remediation and audit closure.

jobs.description:

Harbinger is an American commercial electric vehicle (EV) company on a mission to transform an industry starving for innovation. Harbinger's best\-in\-class team of EV, battery, and drivetrain experts have pooled their deep experience to bring a first\-of\-its\-kind EV platform to support the growing demand for medium\-duty EVs and Hybrids. Harbinger: Familiar Form, Revolutionary Foundation.

**Role Summary**

  

Harbinger is hiring an IT \& Cybersecurity Program Manager to be the operational driver for the IT and Cybersecurity team's roadmap. This person will work side\-by\-side with the IT \& Cybersecurity Director on a daily basis, turning strategy and OKRs into scoped, sequenced, and delivered initiatives.


**What You'll Do:**


* Own the quarterly OKR and project backlog process with the IT Director, scoring, sequencing, and staffing initiatives against team capacity and budget
* Drive cross\-project initiatives spanning IT Engineering, Cybersecurity, and Operations, keeping scope, timelines, dependencies, and risk visible

* Drive the SOX ITGC, SOC 2, and IPO\-readiness security roadmap, including remediation of risk assessment and penetration test findings
* Track vulnerability management, access reviews, and vendor risk assessments against SLAs with Cybersecurity
* Lead vendor evaluations and system implementations from requirements to go live and beyond

About Us:  

  

Twitch is the world’s biggest live streaming service, with global communities built around gaming, entertainment, music, sports, cooking, and more. It is where thousands of communities come together for whatever, every day.  

We’re about community, inside and out. You’ll find coworkers who are eager to team up, collaborate, and smash (or elegantly solve) problems together. You will translate operational data into clear insights that help leadership and partners make informed decisions across Trust \& Safety (T\&S) and Customer Experience (CX). * Track the impact of CT's AI automation programs on volumes, costs, and operational capacity, surfacing findings and recommendations to your manager and stakeholders.

* 401(k)

* Flexible PTO

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

* Experience interacting with local food safety regulators

jobs.title: Business Analyst
jobs.description:
National Community Renaissance (National CORE) is a nonprofit affordable housing developer, but our work is not about bricks and mortar, rather creating healthy communities that thrive and prosper for many generations to come. At National CORE, we support families and seniors by providing housing communities that are affordable, safe, and of the highest quality. We enhance neighborhood stability through long\-term management and maintenance, as well as industry\-leading services such as senior wellness, preschool and afterschool programs, and family financial training.


National COREs Information Technology (IT) department is an ever exciting, dynamic environment. We are focused on empowering our customers through current technology, superior support, and proactive interactions.


As an IT Business Analyst, you will help guide National COREs business in improving financial and property management processes, services, and software by straddling the line between IT and the business to support National COREs vision and strategies.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

The IT Business Analyst performs a variety of basic to advanced technical, administrative, and clerical tasks and maintains departmental service level agreements (SLAs) by providing excellent customer service. The IT Business Analyst will have strong data analytics experience.

**Product and business knowledge.** Demonstrate up\-to\-date expertise in our internal technology management systems and apply this to the development, execution and improvement of action plans by providing advice and guidance to others in the application of information and best practices.

**Process improvement.** Work with the Senior Business Analyst to identify, create, and facilitate process design changes by conducting business and systems process analysis and design at a complex level; focusing on quality improvement and data management; ensuring data is reliable and valid; developing process improvements or re\-engineering and recommending elimination; integrating new systems and processes with existing ones; and partnering with internal and external customers to ensure systems provided meet the long\-term business strategies. Support and align efforts to meet customer and business needs.

**Project management.** Manage customer relationships and expectations by developing a communication process to keep others up to date on project results. Lead or participate in multiple projects by completing and updating project documentation; managing project scope; adjusting schedules when necessary; determining daily priorities; ensuring efficient and on\-time delivery of project tasks and milestones; following proper escalation paths; and managing customer and supplier relationships. Manage budgeting and forecasting process.

**Day\-to\-day.** Provide and support the administration of business solutions by building relationships and partnerships with key stakeholders; resolve issues submitted by through the Information Technology Service Management (ITSM) solution; work with business partners to escalate issues, as needed; and maintain SLAs.


Work with the Senior Business Analyst to identifying business needs; determining and carrying out necessary processes and practices; monitoring progress and results; recognizing and capitalizing on improvement opportunities; and adapting to competing demands, organizational changes and new responsibilities. Day\-to\-day responsibilities may include:

* Support and manage incidents and requests for National COREs business solutions technologies that may include:
	+ Troubleshooting problems and or bugs within the platform
	+ Creating, managing and maintaining user accounts, including onboarding and offboarding users. Provide data driven reports to various stakeholders
	+ Escalating incidents to vendors, as needed
* Platform administration run troubleshooting and system monitoring tools to identify and provide preventative maintenance on systems
* Maintain security integrity \- review, develop user access rights
* Maintain data integrity review data to ensure consistent clean data and work with platform users to ensure processes are in place to create consistency
* Ensure proper service levels are maintained for Yardi support requests by the Service Desk and work with the team to improve support
* Serve as a liaison between Operations and IT to assist or gather business requirements needed for system modifications, enhancement and implementations.
* Assist with and test implementation for all payer and vendor relationships to ensure data transfer collection, quality and reporting relationships are working appropriately down to the market level to ensure market team member and provider experience is appropriate
* Maintain data confidentiality
* Assist Senior Business Analyst in the following: o Provide project level analysis producing required project analysis documentation (business requirements, scope matrix, use cases, sequence diagrams, future state proposals, UAT plan).
	+ Collaborate closely with external developers to implement the requirements, provide necessary guidance to testers during QA process.
	+ Identify improvement opportunities (proactive and reactive).

jobs.description:
**Job ID** REQ20179921 **Category** Accounting, Finance and Banking
  
**Budget/Business Analyst**


**USC School of Architecture**


**Application Procedure**

As part of the application, candidates must upload one document file (Word or PDF) that contains the following: 1\) a cover letter, 2\) Resume (including telephone and e\-mail address). **Make sure to upload both documents to be considered for this position.**

**About the Opportunity**


The University of Southern California **School of Architecture** is looking for a customer\-centric and details\-oriented **Budget/Business Analyst** to join the Business Office Team. The Budget/Business Analyst will be part of a team that manages the accounts and reviews transactions for the school and works closely with students, staff, and faculty on processing business transactions.


**About the University of Southern California**


The University of Southern California is one of the world’s leading private research universities. An anchor institution in Los Angeles, USC has a large number of international students and offers extensive opportunities for internships and study abroad. With a strong tradition of integrating liberal and professional education, USC fosters a vibrant culture of public service and encourages students to cross academic as well as geographic boundaries in their pursuit of knowledge. For more information, visit www.usc.edu.


**About USC School of Architecture**


The School is located on USC’s main University Park Campus (UPC) is located at Watt Hall, Harris Hall, and MacDonald Becket Center (MBC). For more than a century, the USC School of Architecture has shaped the spaces and systems that define how we live, work, and connect. Our mission is to educate and empower the next generation of designers, thinkers, and innovators who will create a more sustainable, inclusive, and resilient world. Rooted in Los Angeles’ global laboratory and connected to an international network of scholars and practitioners, the School of Architecture leverages research, creativity, and collaboration to address the most pressing issues of our time.


In this fast\-paced environment, the Budget/Business Analyst will have responsibilities that include but are not limited to:


**Responsibilities And Duties**


* Assists in local planning of short\- and long\-term budgets by compiling and organizing data for use in forecasts.
* Analyze overall departmental spending versus budget and prepare ad hoc financial reports as requested. Provide detailed transactional data that is easy to understand to help budget administrators make sound decisions regarding their programs.
* Administers assigned budget(s). Monitors actual income and expense and develop projections to authorize or extend financial commitments.
* Forecasts future budget performance based on knowledge of assigned operations.
* Identifies and researches variances and trends and brings to the attention of the supervisor for discussion and resolution.
* Interacts with central departments as a representative of the school including Purchasing, USC Travel Manager, Office of Global Initiatives and Corporate Card Services.
* Coordinated new supplier set up when requested by departments and sees the process until completion.
* Submits Workday access requests based on departmental roles and responsibilities.
* Submits corporate card change requests for procurement and travel cardholders.
* Troubleshoots problems, including research of pertinent facts and interacts with appropriate university staff to achieve resolution.
* Sets up and maintains gift and project accounts and tracks expenditures to assure the accounts stay within budget.
* Set up and maintain Internal Service Deliveries (ISD) for central services related to school operations such as parking, hotel stays, and events.
* Reconciles account balances and activity to university financial records and initiates correcting entries.
* Coordinates fiscal year\-end financial transfer and closing activity with staff and faculty.
* Provides guidance to staff and faculty regarding university expenditure policies and procedures. Assists faculty and staff in financial transactions such as purchasing equipment and supplies and accounting for travel expenditures and reimbursements.
* Reviews procurement card and travel\-card transactions to ensure compliance with university policies.
* Manages purchasing requests and submits requisitions to obtain purchase orders against budget and university guidelines for goods and services.
* Purchases goods for faculty, staff and students who do not have a procurement card and reconcile transactions at the end of the month.
* Manages the Dean’s approval memos for goods and services based on University and School specific expenditure policies.
* Make travel and hotel arrangements for visiting scholars and guests. Submits reimbursement requests for students and school guests as requested.
* Reviews invoices and coordinates with departments to confirm goods and services have been received.
* On a monthly basis, reconcile account balances and activity to the university financial system, researching and bringing budget variances to the attention of the supervisor for discussion and resolution.
* Provide detailed reporting to stakeholders including the Manager Budgetary Balance (MBBR) report as well as detailed transactional journal data that shows trends and where budget expenditures are occurring.
* On a quarterly basis, meet with department chairs, administrators, and supervisors to review their department financial performance.
* In addition, the successful candidate must demonstrate, through ideas, words and actions, a strong commitment to USC’s Unifying Values.

Performs other related duties as assigned or requested. The University reserves the right to add or change duties at any time.


**Experience And Qualifications**


**Education**


Required: Bachelor's degree


Preferred: Master’s degree

jobs.title: Senior People Program Manager, Site Expansions
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

### **ABOUT THE TEAM**



At Anduril, we're not just changing the game – we're redefining it. As our Senior People Program Manager, you will partner with leadership and teams from across the business to unpack ambiguous problems and build lasting, scalable solutions for our new production site launches.

  

### **ABOUT THE JOB**



We are looking for a Sr. People Program Manager to join our rapidly growing team. Partnering with leadership and cross\-functional production, facilities, construction, tech and operations teams, you'll dive deep into our most critical workflows, emerging as the go\-to expert for the organizational architecture of our production facility launches within the People Team. With your strong foundation in project management, a keen understanding of change management, and a commanding executive presence you will oversee project execution to ensure successful business expansion on schedule.

  

#### **WHAT YOU'LL DO**


* You'll both lead and help on critical site launches for leaders in our People and Production org, requiring you to quickly learn new subject matters and create priorities in an ambiguous environment.
* Define and drive the Day\-1 readiness checklist across IT, facilities, HR, and Operations, coordinating workforce implementation, and communications activation for launch.
* You'll build trust across a diverse range cross functional teams to resolve bottlenecks and achieve seamless site expansions and building launches.
* You have an insanely high execution bar and will see projects through from conception to tactical completion to move Anduril forward and remain on schedule.
* You'll use your qualitative and quantitative skill set to help design key analysis to influence and execute on operational decisions, and partner with analysts to execute.
* You will utilize your project management expertise to develop structured and meticulous processes using project briefs, trackers, and data mapping, ensuring timely and on\-schedule project delivery all while keeping the end\-user in mind.
* You'll continuously use your creativity to craft compelling narratives that convey a clear vision, story, or request.
* You'll communicate across teams, bridging different parts of the organization to achieve cross\-functional outcomes.
* Own operational projects end\-to\-end, from Definition, Solution, to Implementation. You will be handed ambiguous, messy problems with little prescription on how to solve them.

#### **REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS**


* Minimum of 6\+ yrs experience in management consulting, change management, internal operations, or program management.
* You are motivated by our mission. We are working to solve the biggest problems in defense. You have a keen interest to partner with key production partners to accomplish manufacturing at scale.
* You get energy from being a thought partner for others and it excites you to spend time creating process.
* You are empathetic: you are eager to see the world from your users' perspective.
* You love solving complex, ambiguous, cross\-functional problems in a people\-centric way. You are a driver of strategic planning.
* You're both high ownership and low ego, approaching everything with strong outcome orientation and high humility.
* You don't wait on others to solve problems. You proactively step into the gap to offer solutions yourself.
* You are comfortable communicating broadly and having a lot of eyes on your work. This role can at\-times require communications to large groups and senior leadership. This should excite you!
* Exceptional communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to present complex information clearly and concisely to diverse audiences
* Ability to interpret complex datasets and extract actionable insights that support business objectives.
* Must be a U.S. Person due to required access to U.S. export controlled information or facilities


The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top\-tier benefits for full\-time employees, including:

jobs.description:
LAZ Parking Regional Parking Data Analyst


Job Title \- Regional Parking Data Analyst



Job Summary



This position reports to regional leadership and partners closely with operations, finance, revenue management, technology, and asset management teams. The role supports a regional portfolio of on\-street and off\-street municipal parking operations and is expected to balance day\-to\-day reporting needs with strategic analysis for long\-term performance improvement.



The Regional Parking Data Analyst analyzes operational, financial, and utilization data across a portfolio of parking enforcement, meter collections, and paid parking facilities in the Los Angeles region. This role supports regional leadership by translating occupancy, revenue, customer behavior, officer productivity, asset performance, and operational efficiency data into clear recommendations. The analyst will work closely with the Business Intelligence team to develop dashboards, perform forecasting, identify revenue growth opportunities, and help drive consistent, data\-informed decision\-making across multiple locations.



Key Responsibilities



Regional Performance Analysis


* Analyze parking occupancy, utilization, turnover, and revenue trends across multiple on and off\-street facilities.


* Monitor regional KPIs, identify performance gaps and risks, and recommend actions that improve revenue, utilization, productivity, service performance, or operating efficiency.


* Provide operational and financial insights to Operations Managers and Senior Leadership.


* Conduct comparative analyses across locations to identify best practices and improvement opportunities.



Reporting \& Dashboard Development


* Support the development and maintenance of regional dashboards, scorecards, and client and executive reports.


* Automate recurring reports to improve efficiency and accuracy.


* Deliver weekly, monthly, and quarterly performance reviews that highlight trends, risks, opportunities, and recommended next steps.


* Create visualizations that clearly communicate trends, explain performance drivers, and support operational and financial decision\-making.



Revenue Management \& Forecasting


* Analyze revenue performance by facility, customer segment, permit type, parking product, daypart, and demand pattern to identify pricing, utilization, and revenue optimization opportunities.


* Monitor transient, event, contract, and monthly parking revenues.



Operations \& Utilization Analytics


* Evaluate occupancy patterns and peak\-demand periods, using GIS software.
* Assess facility capacity utilization and recommend operational improvements.


* Support dynamic pricing and yield management initiatives.


* Analyze staffing levels and labor productivity against facility demand.



Data Quality \& Systems Management


* Ensure accuracy and integrity of operational and financial reporting.


* Collaborate with IT and system vendors to improve reporting capabilities.


* Maintain data governance standards and reporting documentation.



Business Partnership \& Strategic Support


* Collaborate with Regional Operations, Finance, Sales, Revenue Management, and Asset Management teams.


* Present recommendations to regional leadership and corporate stakeholders.


* Support new facility onboarding by establishing baseline reporting, validating source data, and identifying early performance trends.


* Assist in evaluating business cases for technology investments and operational initiatives.



Education:


* Bachelor's Degree in Urban Planning, Operations Management, Information Systems, Business Analytics, or equivalent.


* Master's degree (MBA, Data Analytics, Finance, Statistics, or similar) preferred but not required.



Experience:


* 2 to 3\+ years of experience in one of the following:

o Data analysis



o Business intelligence



o Financial analysis



o Revenue management



o Operations analytics



o Project Management


* Experience working with multi\-site or regional operational portfolios preferred.
* Exposure to parking, transportation, mobility, facilities management, and municipal operations is highly desirable.
* Experience presenting findings to senior leadership and operational stakeholders.


* Able to learn and become proficient in other software applications, such as parking technology.


* Experience in overseeing technology and implementing initiatives that streamline existing processes using technology.

Data Analysis \& Reporting


* Advanced proficiency in:

o Microsoft Office 365, specifically Excel (Power Query, Power Pivot, advanced formulas)



o SQL



o Data modeling and analysis


* Strong experience with:

o Power BI



o Tableau



o Similar business intelligence platforms


* Ability to automate recurring reports and dashboards.


* Experience in trend analysis, KPI development, pricing analysis, scenario modeling.


* Ability to identify revenue optimization opportunities through data analysis.


* Experience with GIS platforms such as – ArcGIS, QGIS, GIS mapping tools.


* Ability to analyze utilization patterns geographically and identify demand trends.

Preferred Qualifications


* Parking industry experience.


* Knowledge of:

o Parking occupancy analytics



o Meter systems



o Enforcement operations



o Permit management



o Dynamic pricing strategies



Skills:


* Ability to seek improvement and create an environment of idea sharing and creative problem solving.


* Strong employee relations skills and abilities.


* Ability to be approachable and facilitate coaching conversations with employees and managers.


* Ability to mitigate and lead others to overcome challenges (Never Ever Give Up Attitude).


* Ability to encourage open expressions of ideas and opinions.

En rejoignant nos équipes en tant que Business Analyst Télécommunications expérimenté, vous propulserez votre carrière en participant à des programmes stratégiques et des projets de transformation majeurs pour les acteurs du secteur des télécommunications.

jobs.title: Global Enablement Program Manager
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description:
Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.  

  

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.  

  

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise\-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.


**Role**



We’re looking for a Global Enablement Program Manager, who can bring to life the Afterpay and Cash App value propositions through our biggest channel: our people. You will have the opportunity to build a global Afterpay and Cash App enablement \& training strategy that educates, supports, and grows our go\-to\-market teams across Sales, Account Management, Partnerships and Customer Success. You will own the program from the ground up, thinking about what matters most, how we best support our teams, and ultimately how we uplevel the skills of our people, to help them surpass their goals. In this role, you will truly have the opportunity to manage a program that is mission critical to our organization's ability to scale, hit goals, and develop top talent.



This is a global role focused on North America, the UK and APAC. You may start the day sending out communications to the US team on recent business updates, followed by an end\-of\-day training session with the Australian team on a tool refresh.


**Responsibilities**



You will develop a global enablement \& training strategy that:


* Educates teams on core value proposition, product launches, business updates and more.
* Supports those teams with the tools to do their best work through training, use cases etc.
* Grows the team’s capability with selling skills, opportunity frameworks, and continuous learning.
* Is a builder when it comes to AI, both building tools and supporting teams to ensure our teams are utilizing all the skills available to them, to be successful in their role.


**Day\-to\-day:**


* Own and manage our internal content platform, ensuring it is clean and up\-to\-date, and most importantly that our teams love and engage with us.
* You’ll be the owner for this workstream end\-to\-end but you’ll collaborate closely with revenue leadership to identify and prioritize improvements to the ongoing sales skills program(s.).
* Balance your time between facilitating training classes, program management responsibilities, and strategic planning.
* Scale globally but think regionally: Take the time to understand the unique needs of each market and build a global enablement program.
* Communicate across the business with product \& business updates, including both email communication and live presentations.
* Closely collaborate with the B2B content \& other GTM functions to ensure their content is driving maximum engagement and utilization internally.


**Qualifications \& Experience**


* 5\+ years of related experiences in sales, sales training, sales enablement, learning \& development or a related field.
* Well versed in learning methodologies and facilitation techniques, especially for a sales team.

jobs.description:
